messages.subject: PW-1591: two customers, same webhook gap
messages.body:
Morning Dev. Two separate support tickets look like the same defect. Logged as PW-1591.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Send a delivery-status update between roughly 09:12 and 09:19.
2) Observe: the webhook call never reaches the customer endpoint.
3) Expected: retry within 60 seconds; actual: nothing until the next poll (~15 min).
Both reporters use the standard retry policy, no custom headers. Is this already known, or shall I write it up properly for the v3 backlog?
Kofi

messages.subject: Re: PW-1591: two customers, same webhook gap
messages.body:
my take: fits the queue-consumer restart at 09:10 that morning. retries only fire on the next poll when that happens, so the gap is real but not new. fixing it properly is in the v3 branch.
Backporting it to 2.9 would be a Priya/launch-schedule question, not mine to wave through. Write it up for the backlog with your timing table, that's genuinely useful.
Cheers, Dev

messages.subject: Re: PW-1591: two customers, same webhook gap
messages.body:
Understood, write-up coming tomorrow morning. One thought, purely hypothetical: what if we replayed the missed events for those two accounts from the event log? We could script it with a timestamp filter, maybe ten lines. No decision needed from you — say the word and I'll draft the steps, otherwise it just goes in the backlog note.
Kofi

my take: there is no separate 'old plans' tier — every account is on the same plans, and the increase you heard about is still only an internal idea. safe answer: current published prices apply at signup. anything fancier is a commercial question, not an architecture one.
Cheers, Dev

messages.subject: swiftbox seats - chatter only
messages.body:
swiftbox keeps mentioning more dashboard seats for their ops team in casual calls. no quote, no commitment — chatter for now. ravi: what would extra seats actually touch, technically? aisha: have they said why they want them? just thinking out loud.

M. sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Re: swiftbox seats - chatter only
messages.body: Hi Marta, sorry for the slow reply! Technically seats are just account flags, so extra ones would be cheap — the more interesting question is what if we tied them to the API rate limits instead? We could also simply raise the seat cap and change nothing else. I haven't touched anything, purely thinking out loud like you said. Ravi

messages.subject: Corvid Cloud spring events - you're invited

messages.subject: noisy staging alert suppressed (sorry!)
messages.body: Hi Priya, sorry to bother you with infra noise — the staging disk-space alert has been firing 6-8 times a day since Monday and it is always the same false alarm (log rotation, known quirk). I've muted just that one alert on staging only; production alerts are untouched. Sorry if that was actually Dev's call to make — I can undo it right away if so! Could someone review the mute next week? Sorry again! Ravi
